name: Standing Calf Raise
heavyWhy: calf raise: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)
setup: Shoulders under the pads, balls of your feet on the edge, knees straight.
form: Lower your heels all the way, pause 2 s.
Rise as high as you can.
tips: The pause at the bottom matters most.
rangeOfMotion: Heels all the way down → all the way up
tempo: Down 3 s · Hold 2 s · Up 1 s

preferred.why: Straight knees stretch the upper calf: grew it far more than seated raises.

name: Seated Calf Raise
heavyWhy: calf raise: very heavy loads in a short range (Leo's call: ★)

form: Lower your heels all the way, pause 2 s.
Rise as high as you can.
rangeOfMotion: Heels all the way down → all the way up
tempo: Down 3 s · Hold 2 s · Up 1 s

preferred.why: Covers the bent-knee angle (soleus); pair it with a standing raise.
